meta.title: GitKittie — Small apps built on your own git
meta.description: GitKittie makes GitKittie Folder, GitKittie Tasks, GitKittie Bud and GitKittie Mail: small, local-first apps for Mac, iPhone and iPad that work on what you already have — your own git repositories, and your own mail account. No GitKittie accounts, no GitKittie servers.

hero.title: Small apps, built on *your own git.*
hero.subtitle: Focused, local-first apps on the setup you already have — git repositories on GitHub, GitLab or anywhere else, and the mail account you already use. No accounts, no servers, no lock-in.

shot.alt: GitKittie Tasks on the Mac: a task board whose lanes and cards are markdown files in a git repository.

statement.text: Your files, in your repositories, on the machines you own. GitKittie builds the small native apps that sit on top of that.

apps.title: Four apps, *one idea.*
apps.subtitle: Keep your work in plain files you own — and get a native app that makes it effortless. Pick the one you need; they share the same principles.

items.name: GitKittie Folder
items.tagline: Version history for your folders on Mac, and your repos as folders on iPhone.
points: Automatic snapshot commits when files change
Browse and edit your repos on iPhone and iPad
Uses the GitHub or GitLab access you already have

items.name: GitKittie Tasks
items.tagline: A task board whose only data source is a git repo of markdown.
points: Your board is a git repo of markdown files
Share a screenshot on iPhone and it becomes a task
Agents work on the board, and you review what they make

items.name: GitKittie Bud
items.tagline: A git client that makes rewriting history visual — and safe to undo.
points: Rebase, split, squash and reorder by pointing at commits
Every rewrite is previewed and lands on a safety ref first
Branch graph, file history and pull requests in one window

items.name: GitKittie Mail
items.tagline: A calmer inbox on the address you already have, with every message kept as a file you own.
points: A Focused inbox, sorted on your device
Sender rules, safe unsubscribe and cleanup you can undo
Works with iCloud Mail and standard IMAP accounts

principles.title: The same promises, *in every app.*
principles.subtitle: They hold across the family because the data is always the same thing — your files, on your devices and in accounts you already own.

features.title: Local-first & private
features.desc: No GitKittie account, no cloud service. Your files move directly between your device and the git host or mail provider you already use.

features.title: Your own files
features.desc: Folder, Tasks and Bud read and write plain git repositories you own; Mail keeps every message as a plain .eml file. Nothing is locked into a proprietary format or backend.

features.title: Built on what you already use
features.desc: They lean on accounts you already trust — the same repositories, keys and permissions on GitHub, GitLab or anywhere else, and the same mail address at your provider.

features.title: Native, not a web wrapper
features.desc: Small, focused apps built with SwiftUI for each platform — each does one thing well and stays out of your way.

cta.title: Own your data. *Keep owning it.*
cta.subtitle: GitKittie Folder and GitKittie Tasks are on the Mac App Store and the App Store. GitKittie Bud and GitKittie Mail are in development.
